text:
Morning weekend crew,
Measured stretch behind us, one thing is left: farewell routines

Hello team,

We are in the final push for the weekend handoff, and I need everyone on the Companion Animal Travel Desk to stay sharp, brief, and calm with every traveler and pet. Keep the intake notes clean, confirm carrier checks, and make sure each family hears the same clear guidance from the first conversation to the last. If a case feels unsettled, flag it at once instead of letting it drift.

Please pay close attention to lounge access, transfer support, and the paperwork that follows each arrival. <<FACT F021>> Keep a steady eye on kennel labels, hydration requests, and any special handling notes already in the file. If Nora Dubois, Noah Nakamura, or Marley come through your queue, give the same careful review you would give any other traveler, and do not assume a previous handoff covered every detail.

We also need fast coordination with the gate side when a pet is waiting longer than expected, because small delays can become larger problems quickly. Use plain language, repeat only what matters, and record every update before moving to the next case. If you are unsure about a release, hold the handoff and ask for confirmation rather than guessing. The whole point is to leave the desk orderly, humane, and ready for the next shift without confusion.

Please keep your focus tight, your notes complete, and your tone steady with the public. Every careful handoff protects the animal, supports the family, and helps Aurelia Skyways finish strong.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
